field_principles.attempts: bare int count of live actions executed.
field_principles.collapse_detected_live: bare bool: the anti-stagnation controller actually fired during THIS live run (not a replayed trace).
field_principles.collapse_trigger_step: the step index collapse first fired, or null if it never fired (a genuine no-collapse run is also an honest, valid result).
field_principles.duration_s: real wall-clock time; a genuine GPU LLM run over a 46-action budget takes well over 60s.
field_principles.forced_portfolio_activated_live: bare bool: the deterministic diverse portfolio was actually installed as the ranked candidates at least once live.
field_principles.honest_verdict: one-line verdict starting complete: or blocked:.
field_principles.inference_substrate: live_llm_inference when llm_strategy_proposer_used_any_step is true, else the honest no-LLM substrate.
field_principles.llm_strategy_proposer_used_any_step: bare bool proving real GGUF inference occurred at least once (the exp5534 dishonest-baseline failure mode this guards against).
field_principles.max_level_reached: highest level counter observed during this single fresh env session.
field_principles.model_specs: the local GGUF proposer actually invoked.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: true only when a claimed new level passes the standard offline replay gate.
field_principles.post_collapse_strategy_diversity: unique forced-portfolio category count selected in the step(s) after collapse fired; the direct behavioral escape signal.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: resources verified before any live inference was attempted.
field_principles.prior_levels_reproduced: registry depth for target_game before this attempt.
field_principles.registry_delta: nonzero only when offline_reproduced is true.
field_principles.reproduced_levels: integer new levels banked; secondary to the collapse-escape headline, not required for a valid result.
field_principles.solve_provenance: must equal live_agent_self_discovery -- the scored E3AgentPolicy path, not a hand-derived outer-loop solve.
field_principles.target_game: current shallowest not-fully-cleared registry game, re-read live so the target can never go stale.
field_principles.target_level: the next unreproduced level for target_game at run time.
field_principles.trajectory_path: path to the full step-by-step diagnostics log for audit.
